scope: Train one tiny causal Transformer LM architecture from scratch; inspect full next-token distributions. No pretrained LLM or language competence claim.

tokenizer.rule: Unicode letters/marks/numbers or individual non-whitespace symbols, no case folding

architecture.kind: one pre-LayerNorm causal self-attention block, no cross-attention
architecture.head: untied affine vocabulary projection

training.loss: mean next-token cross-entropy over teacher-forced input BOS..dot and targets first word..EOS
training.selection: final fixed step only, report all three seeds; no winner selection

splitRule: All 6*3*4=72 authored combinations; (subjectIndex+verbIndex+objectIndex)%5: 0 test,1 dev,otherwise train
controls: unigram target frequencies fit train only, no context
alter future suffix keeping four-token prefix identical: causal prefix logits must stay fixed
same suffix contrast with causal mask disabled: diagnostic only, NOT a trained masked LM
export full probabilities/logits, log-loss, token accuracy and sample IDs for every split
limits: Closed synthetic grammar and shared templates/prefixes across splits, not independent natural-language test
Some next tokens have multiple valid continuations; a single observed target is not the only meaningful continuation
No held-out domain or grammar, no publication benchmark, no latency/GPU claims
Training only causal decoder-style LM; encoder masked LM and encoder-decoder explained separately without attributing an absent experiment
Context cap16positions, one sentence at a time; BOS/EOS, not chat template
